The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of a rapidly uplifting area with uniform lithology and climate, the elevation of a basin can be used as a proxy for uplift rate.
the study of the relationships between relief and uplift is a promising approach to the study of the tectonic and climatic controls on landscape evolution.
, in a tectonically active area, the relief of topographic features is not only a function of the tectonic uplift rate but also of the efficiency of the denudation process.
